heading: **11 February 2026**
body:
*lig147 & ligN40 plate preparation*  
Concentration of original lig147 ssDNA tube is about 4.8 ug/uL

Dilute this 1:200 ⇒ 2 uL oligo \+ 398 uL TE buffer (lig147-dil200)

PCR 1 → 100X

| Reagent | Volume (µL) |
| ----- | ----- |
| **Final diluted DNA** | **100** |
| **Phusion Master Mix** | **2500** |
| **NCAP\_F (10 µM)** | **250** |
| **NCAP\_R (10 uM)** | **250** |
| **Water** | **1900**  |
| **Total** | **5000** |

25 uL per well in two 96-well plates.

| 98°C | 3 min |
| :---- | :---- |
| 98°C | 10 s |
| 55°C | 15 s       **8X\*** |
| 72°C | 30 s |
| 72°C | 40 min |
| 4°C | HOLD |

Concentration of lig147 PCR1 (combine and mix with previous PCR1 product) \= **22.6 ng/uL**
title: lig147 & ligN40 plate preparation
